title: linum usitatissimum var. humile
intro: Linum usitatissimum var. humile, commonly known as dwarf flax, is a type of plant belonging to the Linaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used for centuries to promote health and well-being. The health benefits of Linum usitatissimum var. humile include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to act as an emollient, a demulcent, and an anti-irritant, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
